limitations: All results are retrospective unless independently timestamped before draw. Holdout label refers to date split, not proof of untouched data.
Wilson intervals describe day-level hit counts under independence; temporal dependence and multiple comparisons are not adjusted.
Uniform independent-tail null is theoretical, not a payout or profit model.
Legacy comparison is limited to overlapping published calendar dates. Personal is evaluated locally in the browser; no birth data exported.
